name: cta-overlay
description: 2-second branded FOLLOW CTA overlay — renders 3 variants with transparent background (alpha channel) for drop-in use over any TikTok/Short export.

scripts.render:reward: npx remotion render src/index.ts cta-reward out/cta-reward.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.render:curiosity: npx remotion render src/index.ts cta-curiosity out/cta-curiosity.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.render:social: npx remotion render src/index.ts cta-social out/cta-social.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444
scripts.render:all: npm run render:reward && npm run render:curiosity && npm run render:social
